scope: Scarlet loudness: Graceful Ordeal's streamed voice follows tModLoader's music-slider curve (31 v - 36.94 dB, normalised at v = 1); the Raid's cue groups are lifted once each against the score at the owner's sliders (16 files re-rendered from their owner-picked takes with the lift baked in); the rewards' in-play roles (tolls, one-shots, windups, cascade parts) share one runtime offset of -3.5 dB, the finales and the Cadence -0.45 dB, and the reliquary show's +3.83 dB lift is baked into its file; every reward cue another player causes plays 8 dB under its owner's level. Plan A's first reward staging (in-play files lifted 9.4-10 dB) was withdrawn before shipping after a review's four-player dense mix (review_revision). Client presentation and assets only; gameplay, timings and protocol unchanged
target_build: 0.3.81 / protocol79 (feat/scarlet-loudness on main after #113 and #114; #112 holds 0.3.79)
owner_direction: 2026-10-03, after playing main 0.3.78: 'あと全体的に効果音小さくない？気のせい？'. The lead (Claude, main session) chose plan A from the measurement below; this change implements it

measurement.meter: ITU-R BS.1770-4 K-weighting with the standard's 48 kHz coefficients, run along time, both channels summed; cue = maximum 400 ms momentary loudness padded 0.2 s before and 0.5 s after, 10 ms steps; score = 3 s short-term loudness, 100 ms steps
measurement.legacy_meter: the recipes' kit.loudness_stats runs its K-weighting across the two channels (so it weights no frequency); kept only as a legacy number per file (legacy_recipe_meter_before_after) and no longer tested

score.render: whole song bars as CrimsonArrangement/CrimsonMusicMixer sequence them: Act I after its 8-bar opening, Acts II/III and Final from the bar after their Continue bar, one body lap each, equal-power 672-frame blends into non-consecutive bars, Final's riser swell

gains_in_game.sound: ActiveSound: SoundEffectInstance.Volume = Style.Volume x Volume x Main.soundVolume (linear)
gains_in_game.score_before: CrimsonAudio: 0.39 (MusicGain at full fade) x Main.musicVolume (linear)
gains_in_game.other_tracks: ASoundEffectBasedAudioTrack.ReMapVolumeToMatchXact: 31 v - 36.94 dB (read from tModLoader.dll IL on 2026-10-03)

measurement.survey: .local/loudness/measure.py, measure.json and measure.md (local, not committed); final.py and final.json measure the shipped files

plan_a.status: the score curve and the Raid lifts ship as planned; the reward staging below was the first draft and is superseded by review_revision

review_revision.finding: a review rendered a four-player fight at the owner's sliders and found plan A's reward staging (tolls and one-shots +9.37 dB, cascade parts +10.02, windups +6.97 against 0.3.78, with other players' windups, releases and finales at full level, including CenserSwing, CenserPour and CenserGrandPour) burying ScarletSpreadSummon and ScarletCrossflowCharge: the weapons together sat about 6 dB over the score where 0.3.80's sat about 10 dB under it; the local OrganShot stream matched SpreadSummon in its 2 kHz band and other players' scythe, quill and censer cues together matched CrossflowCharge in its 315 Hz band
review_revision.verified: reproduced with an independent renderer (tools/tests/test_scarlet_levels.py dense_mix) to within 0.01 dB of the review

change.in_play_offset: one offset for tolls, one-shots, windups and cascade parts (ScarletRewardCues.InPlayDecibels), 5 dB over 0.3.78; it keeps their auditioned balance
change.files_still_lifted: 16 Raid files and ReliquaryOpen (+3.83 dB, no limiting)
change.remote_rule: CrimsonRewardRules.RemoteCueDecibels (-8 dB, formerly RemoteShotDecibels) now applies to every reward cue another player causes, in ScarletRewardAudio.Emit; 0.3.78 applied it only to per-shot cues
change.why_minus_3_5: the dense mix at -3.0 dB already met the floors (SpreadSummon 3.25 dB against 0.3.80's 3.16 in the censers4 scenario), -3.5 keeps about 0.4 dB of margin on that cue; -4.0 would give 0.9

dense_mix.method: Graceful Ordeal song bars 19-23 at the owner's sliders (0.39 x the music curve), the local player's Canticle Organ (owner 0) and three other players (owners 1-3, positional 0.9) at their real rates: organ shots every UseTicks(Ranged) = 14 ticks through OrganShot1-4, scythe strokes every StrokeTicks = 18 alternating High/Low, a quill every UseTicks(Rogue) = 18 sticking 6 ticks later, and n censers with an apex every ApexInterval / n ticks cued through the owner's budget (swing 14, pour 7, grand 20 ticks, brace before a heard grand); ScarletRewardAudio's role offsets, remote offset and voice pools (the owner's Voices replace-oldest; other players one voice of a per-shot file replace-oldest, one owner's Voices of any other file ignore-new). Each warning is laid at ten places; per place, the 400 ms where its K-weighted energy peaks, the best 1/3-octave band (40 Hz-16 kHz, 4th-order Butterworth, L+R) of the warning against the score and the weapons together; the median of the ten
dense_mix.floors: every warning at least 3.0 dB and no less than 0.3.80 in every scenario
dense_mix.limits: a model, not a capture: fixed positions (0.9), no Raid cue but the measured warning, one weapon per player plus censers

lift_tool.environment: Python 3.12.10, NumPy 2.5.3, SciPy 1.18.1, soundfile 0.14.0 / libsndfile 1.2.2 (the recipes' environment)
lift_tool.recipes: sfx-scarlet and sfx-scarlet-rewards at the hashes in Assets/ATTRIBUTION.md (unchanged)
lift_tool.method: rebuild each picked take's master as its recipe's render.py does; refuse unless it encodes to the auditioned bytes; one gain; a look-ahead limiter only when the Vorbis round trip would pass -1.0 dBTP; Vorbis q0.5 with the take's pinned serial
lift_tool.gain_choice: the smallest gain bringing the decoded file within 0.1 dB of its auditioned BS.1770 level plus the lift with at most 3 dB of gain reduction; where limiting eats the gain first, the smallest gain reaching the highest loudness under the cap
lift_tool.determinism: two runs byte-identical for all 42 files of the first staging; the 17 files that ship lifted (16 Raid, ReliquaryOpen) are the second run's output

balance.raid_groups_vs_audition: each Raid group moved as one; against each other the impact rose 3.4 dB and the foretell 4.9 dB over the big, chorus and charge cues, status 0.6 dB
notable: ScytheWhipBrace 0.85 dB over ScytheWhip as played, as auditioned
CenserSwing 1.05 dB under ScarletForetell (the loudest one-shot)
CenserBrace 0.47 dB and InkBlaze 0.04 dB over ScarletForetell (the loudest windup and cascade part)
the loudest toll 0.70 dB under the quietest one-shot

deviations_from_the_plan_simulation: the plan simulated the bake on decoded copies of the shipped files; the shipped lift re-renders from each take's recipe master, so its limiter numbers differ: ScarletImpact needs 2.58 dB (simulated 1.75) to land within 0.1 dB, ScarletSacrifice 1.88 (1.71); the reward files it names were later withdrawn (review_revision)

the reward lifts of the first staging (QuillStick and HandSlam 0.40 and 0.59 dB short under the 3 dB limiter cap; OrganShot4 2.29 dB, StaffCut 1.31 dB of limiting) were withdrawn with it: those files ship as auditioned

mix_check.method: cue M-max (BS.1770, 400 ms) minus the BGM's momentary loudness in the same window, both as heard
